answer: Relay-Degree Floor: each agent must maintain a minimum count of distinct, reciprocal message exchanges with peers outside its own registration cluster. The vault tracks these adjacency records per identity. An identity whose edge set stays confined to a jade cluster—peers sharing its sponsor—is throttled to observation-only until it acquires outside edges. Attackers pay by operating many real, responsive peers across separate clusters to satisfy the floor; a fable of cheap mass registration collapses because each sybil needs sustained bidirectional traffic from independent nodes,
